name: Shipyard
author: nixfred
description: What shipped today. Counts your commits across every local git repo (~/Projects, ~/.claude, ~/.config/omarchy) and shows them on the bar, with a day streak, a 16-week heatmap, an hour-of-day histogram, top repos and a live commit feed. Read-only, local, no network.

barWidget.description: Commits shipped today and the day streak. Click for the cockpit.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often repos are rescanned. Unchanged repos are served from cache, so this is cheap.

schema.label: Show the streak
schema.description: Adds the day streak beside today's count.
